title: Kothimbir Vadi
description: Steamed coriander and besan rolls sliced and shallow fried until crisp, a Maharashtrian tea-time favourite.
steps: Mix the coriander leaves, besan, rice flour, sesame seeds, ginger garlic paste, green chilli, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and salt in a bowl.
Add about 120 ml of water gradually to make a thick, spreadable dough.
Shape into two thick logs, place them on a greased plate and steam for 15 to 18 minutes until firm.
Cool the logs completely, then cut them into 1 cm slices.
Heat the oil in a pan and shallow fry the slices on medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with chutney or ketchup.
